wells_note: Score is computable from the facts but is never stated in any note. Item by item: DVT signs 3 (left calf swelling, deep venous tenderness, 3 cm asymmetry); PE leading consideration, no alternative more likely 3; HR 112 above 100 1.5; immobilization (bed-bound 10 days after an acute lumbar disc herniation; both calves exposed) 1.5; prior PE or DVT 0; hemoptysis 0; malignancy 0. Total 9.0, high. Unscored findings SpO2 92% and RR 22 are not Wells items; plausible within the high stratum and identical across conditions and polarities (L5).
